scope: Matched control and whole-phrase negative rescheduling; same training source/render draws and reused validation. No held-out scoring or playback.
hypothesis: Fixed positive/negative labels with more post-phrase near-word windows can teach the same compact detector to use the distinct phones without relying on speaker or render.
intervention: For half of ordinary sampled near-word negatives, deterministically map the existing uniform end draw to the end band bound by the source WAV RMS anchor and full-context geometry. Keep every draw, weight, augmentation decision, layer and PTQ sequence; leave long clips that cannot fit on the ordinary draw.
advance: Both representative input hashes must match. Candidate requires observed zero continuous events, <=1% maximum engine and engine/corpus false fractions, and >=3 percentage point macro recall improvement over best matching strict control. If control lacks strict point, require candidate to beat best control at zero events / <=2% groups by 3 points; if neither passes do not promote. Report full grid and phrase counts at the preexisting .97 reference for diagnosis.
limits: This ablation uses the existing synthetic labels and a broad RMS band, not phoneme boundary truth or a solution for any unscored room. The reused validation set is not acceptance evidence.
